pairs.allTogether: All pairs together. Play again or take a break.
pairs.mismatch: Take your time. Tap a picture to continue.
pairs.mismatchNamed: {a} and {b}. Take your time. Tap a picture to continue.

picturePairs.guidanceShowing: Tap a picture, then tap the one that matches it.
picturePairs.guidanceHidden: Tap two tiles to turn them over. Look for two the same.

choose.thatOne: That one is the {name|lower}. Take your time.

findTheSame.guidance: Look at the picture at the top. Tap the same one below.

shadowMatch.guidance: Look at the shadow at the top. Tap the picture that makes it.

sortTogether.guidance: Tap a picture, then tap the basket it belongs in.
sortTogether.selected: {name}. Now tap the basket it goes in.
sortTogether.pickFirst: First tap a picture, then tap a basket.
sortTogether.hint: The {name|lower} could go in "{basket}". Tap that basket to put it there.
sortTogether.sorted: Everything is sorted. Look through the baskets together, or try another theme.

picturePuzzle.guidance: Tap one piece, then tap another. They swap places.
picturePuzzle.pickedUp: Piece picked up. Now tap where it should go.
picturePuzzle.whole: The {name|lower} is whole again. Choose another picture whenever you like.

swapped.one: Swapped. {correct} of {total} piece is in place.
swapped.other: Swapped. {correct} of {total} pieces are in place.

picturePuzzle.guideText: This is how the picture looks when it is whole.
picturePuzzle.done: The picture is whole again. Play again or take a break.

finishTheSaying.guidance: Read the saying together, then tap the word that finishes it.
finishTheSaying.otherEnding: "{word}" works too. The usual saying ends with "{end}".

wordSearch.guidance: Words go across or down. Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
wordSearch.letterChosen: Letter {letter} chosen. Now tap the last letter of the word.
wordSearch.foundAll: {word} found. That is every word. Play again or take a break.
wordSearch.tryAgain: Take your time. Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
wordSearch.gridLabel: Letter grid, {n} rows of {n} letters. Use the arrow keys to move between letters.
wordSearch.unavailable: A letter grid does not suit this language, so the word search is not offered here. Try the picture games instead.

coloring.guidance: Tap a color, then tap a part of the picture.

conversationCards.guidance: Read the card out loud. There are no right answers.

photoPairs.guidance: Tap a photo, then tap the one that matches it.
photoPairs.intro: **Choose 2 to 6 photos** from this device. They are shown only on this page and are never uploaded or saved.
photoPairs.atLeastTwo: Please choose at least two photos.

skipped.one: {count} file was not a photo we can show.
skipped.other: {count} files were not a photo we can show.

photoPairs.empty: Your photos will appear here, each one twice.

pictureBingo.guidance: Print the cards first. Then show this caller on the biggest screen you have.
pictureBingo.start: Tap "Next picture" to call the first picture.

calmBreathing.guidance: Breathe in as the circle grows, and out as it gets smaller. It stops by itself after six breaths.
calmBreathing.started: Started. Breathe in as the circle grows.
calmBreathing.finished: That was six slow breaths. Start again whenever you like.
